raw_text: My dad just forwarded me a WhatsApp audio of PM supposedly saying reservations will be abolished. It sounds incredibly realistic but FactCheckIndia has already confirmed it's an AI deepfake. The voice cloning technology is getting scary good. This kind of election interference is going to be a massive problem. How do we protect elections when anyone can generate convincing fake audio of political leaders?
clean_text: Reddit discussion on viral PM deepfake audio circulating on WhatsApp. FactCheckIndia confirmed AI deepfake. Users concerned about election interference from convincing voice cloning technology.
